title: Laboratory Safety Handbook
key_sentences: This handbook sets out the rules that keep everyone safe in the institute’s laboratories.
It applies to staff, students and visitors from the moment they enter a laboratory.
Never work alone in a laboratory after 18:00.
The table shows which equipment is required for each type of task.
Chemicals are stored by hazard class and never alphabetically.
Flammable liquids belong in the ventilated cabinet next to the door.
When the alarm sounds, leave the laboratory immediately and close the door behind you.
Do not use the lifts, and do not return until the safety officer allows it.
This handbook is reviewed every year by the safety committee.
Printed copies are not controlled; the current version is on the intranet.

list_items.text: Handling, storage and disposal of chemicals
look for cracks, holes and stains
check that goggles seal against the face
Store coats and goggles outside the laboratory
Report damaged equipment to the safety officer
Warn the people around you and stop the work
Put on gloves and goggles, then
cover the spill with absorbent material
sweep the material into a labelled bag
Wash the area with water and soap
